description: The line plot illustrates the reliability score of SQL generation as a function of cost for three different model ensembles: 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis, labeled "Cost," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10. The y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score," is also a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90. The 3-Model Ensemble is represented by a blue line with circle markers, the 2-Model Ensemble by a red line with circle markers, and GPT-4 by a yellow line with circle markers. The 3-Model Ensemble starts with a reliability score of approximately 85 at a cost of 0 and ends with a score of around 70 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble begins with a score of about 90 and decreases to around 75. GPT-4 starts with the highest score of approximately 90 and shows a sharp decline to a score of about 50. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions.
